scope.productionSelector: tracked source files under royal-identity/RoyalIdentity* projects
method: Enumerate every eligible file under both upstream roots and every tracked production source file.
Review normalized source-line/token similarity to find renamed candidates and false positives.
Inspect Git introduction/history and relevant completed implementation plans.
Classify every candidate as derived or independent; pending classifications are forbidden.
